rule_adjustments.current_problem: The provider wall test treats any token wall as a structural wall unless a short mounted vocabulary matches. picture and rod names therefore advertise surface:wall and require floor.
rule_adjustments.proposal: Authored wall-mounted/wallmounted must disable structural-wall provider inference as well as taking precedence for requires wall. Preserve actual floor-supported left-wall-shell as a wall provider.

additional_verified_case.simulation: Overlay only root-approved wall-mounted tag in memory before enrich_library

result.reason: Editorial semantic suggestion; does not establish runtime placement, collision, seam, scale, or support geometry. This clean view is an inferred proxy for a baked source crop, not an exact recovered hidden surface.

additional_verified_case.finding: Requires wall becomes correct but tool falsely provides wall until mounted-fixture provider exclusion is fixed.

rule_adjustments.current_problem: Any table/tabletop/desk/workbench token advertises surface:tabletop. Single tabletop candlestick, left desk candle and small blue desk device wrongly become providers. Adding tabletop tags to other small props would reproduce this bug.
rule_adjustments.proposal: Treat authored tabletop as required support only. Advertise surface:tabletop only for an explicit provider role or an actual table/desk/workbench/counter/altar object noun, not context/modifier such as on desk, desk candle, tabletop candlestick, on workbench. Keep real small-side-table provider.

rule_adjustments.current_problem: New house actual small-side-table clean FRONT correctly provides tabletop, but its canonical primary parent is a reconstruction patch. central_rules registers only canonical non-view world assets, so no house provider enters the candidates list, including this real table.
rule_adjustments.verified_result: In-memory central_rules for gameplay yields zero house-* candidates, although house-katia--small-side-table.front advertises tabletop.
rule_adjustments.proposal: If new inferred physical furniture is intended to advertise support, resolve one trusted clean principal representative per canonical parent, preserving canonical self-exclusion and avoiding six duplicate provider entries. Do not advertise raw baked source patches as usable tiles. This is a bounded actual-table case, not a new surface taxonomy.

confirmed_existing_fixes.house-crafting--hanging-tool-1..5: Already authored wall-mounted by root; current catalog is stale until final materialization. Do not duplicate a ceiling-rule repair.

unchanged_or_qualified.decision: Correct structural floor/wall and actual table providers; preserve.

Native supports are bed/chair upholstery. Existing surface vocabulary has no bed/chair-top; do not invent a new taxonomy or assert a generic tabletop is the exact native support in this bounded audit.
Native occurrence near wall/crate is too small to prove a wall hook versus leaning/resting support; retain qualified support rather than author wall-mounted without stronger evidence.
Visible upper support caps could optionally be authored tabletop providers in a later bounded provider review; not required to fix obvious fixture/prop misclassification here.
